name: Valdelosa (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white at the lower hoist and green at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdelosa (a slate on green and a Maltese cross on red).
history: The arms of Valdelosa were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 11 January 1994; the municipal flag was approved on 24 June 1994 and is parted per bend of silver and green, charged with the crowned municipal arms.

features.role: Valdelosa arms — slate on green and Maltese cross on red
